sources.title: Seriki/Lmlm · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model is released under a permissive Apache 2.0 license and it features configurable reasoning effort—low, medium, or high, so users can balance output quality and latency based on their needs. The model offers full chain-of-thought visibility to support easier debugging and increased trust, though this output is not intended for end users.

sources.title: Pre-training Limited Memory Language Models with Internal and External ...
sources.snippet: To realize this vision, we introduce Limited Memory Language Models (LmLm), a new class of language models with a pre-training recipe that teaches the model to query an external database for entity-level facts rather than memorizing them. We provide an integrated solution for LmLm s spanning data preparation, pre-training, and inference.
